intro: Answered Questions is an Alliance quest concluding a cross-continental investigation into the disappearance of the night elf priestess Velinde Starsong. Following clues across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, an adventurer returns to Darnassus to deliver a final report to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We shall rein in the worgen problem, have no worry of that. This evil that your friend introduced to our woods will be contained, and I bear her no ill will for her actions. Strange events are afoot in these times, friend, and the darkness knows no respite.
I will keep you no longer. I suspect that there are others that should hear of what you have found in the mines of Duskwood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So this is the fate of Velinde, is it? The high priestess will be disappointed to hear of this, they were good friends before her disappearance. Still, the Scythe of Elune was surely granted to her as a boon by our goddess, and it is unsettling to me that it has fallen out of her servants' hands.
Another matter for another time, however. I owe you my thanks in no small amount for what you have accomplished.
